authShell.privacyNotice: We only use your data for shift planning, with no ads and no tracking. Learn more in the {privacyLink}.

otherProviderHint.title: Your account is connected with {otherDb}
otherProviderHint.text: Your roles from {authProviderShort} do not apply here: you join a {unitTerm} via its link or an invitation, and only those logged in with {authProviderShort} can create a shift plan. An account can only be connected to one association database. If you have a different email address in {authProviderShort}, you can log in with «Log in with {authProviderShort}» to get a separate account with your roles.

start.title: Log in
start.subtitleGeneral: One login for all {unitTermPlural} and events.
start.loginWithEmailSubtitle: Secure account for shifts, profile & notifications
start.chooseEmailPassword: Choose email address and personal password
start.quickAccessWithoutEmail: Quick access without email address for {name}
start.leadAtOtherOrgs: Are you a leader at Cevi, Scouts or Jubla?

start.hitobitoEmailOtherProvider: There is already an account associated with {otherDb} using the email address from your {authProviderShort} profile. An account can only be connected to one association database. You can log in here with your email and password (no password yet? «Forgot password» sets one), but your roles from {authProviderShort} won't apply. To make them count, update your email in {authProviderShort} and log in again.

nickname.title: Log in with {nicknameTerm}

nickname.inviteRequiredText: {name} only accepts new members via a personal invitation link.
nickname.securityWarningTitle: Important security notice: No password protection

nickname.stufenTitle: Which groups/levels are you part of?
nickname.stufenSubtitle: Select all that apply. None is fine too.
nickname.nextTimeNotice: Next time you log in here with your {nicknameTerm} and date of birth. For organizing tasks in the committee, you need an account with {options}.

password.loginSubtitle: Log in with your email and personal password.
password.registerSubtitle: Create a password-protected account for all {unitTermPlural}.
password.existingAccountCalloutTitleVerein: Already have an account with Cevi, Scouts or Jubla?
password.existingAccountCalloutTextVerein: If you previously logged in via Cevi.DB, PBS MiData or Jubla-DB, you can set a password for your existing email address via {resetLink} and log in normally.
password.existingAccountCalloutTextOrg: If you previously logged in only with {authProviderShort}, you can set a password for your existing email address via {resetLink} and log in normally.

verifySent.title: Verify email
verifySent.sentTo: We sent a confirmation link to <bold>{email}</bold>.
verifySent.instructions: Please click the link in the email to activate your account. Check your spam folder if the email doesn't arrive within a few minutes.
verifySent.resendSuccess: A new confirmation link has been sent.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot password?
forgotPassword.instructionsOrg: Enter the email address of your account. We will send you a link to set a new password. Also works for accounts with {orgName} login to set up a password.
forgotPassword.instructionsVerein: Enter the email address of your account. We will send you a link to set a new password. Also works for accounts with Cevi.DB, PBS MiData or Jubla-DB login to set up a password.
forgotPassword.noPasswordNeededOrg: With {authProviderShort} or {nicknameTerm} you don't need a password: simply log in that way again.
forgotPassword.noPasswordNeededVerein: With {nicknameTerm} you don't need a password: simply log in that way again.
forgotPassword.valid2Hours: The link is valid for 2 hours.

resetPassword.title: New password
resetPassword.description: Choose a password with at least 8 characters that you don't use anywhere else.
resetPassword.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
resetPassword.changedDescription: You can now log in with your email and new password. You have been logged out on other devices.
resetPassword.linkExpiredDescription: This link is invalid, already used or older than 2 hours. Simply request a new one.

twoFactor.subtitleApp: {providerNotice}Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for {orgName}.
twoFactor.subtitleRecovery: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each code can only be used once.
twoFactor.expiredDescription: The code must be entered within 10 minutes of entering the password. Please log in again.
twoFactor.switchToRecovery: No access to the app? Use recovery code
twoFactor.lostDeviceNotice: Lost your phone and recovery codes? Contact the shift plan administrators. They can reset two-factor authentication after verification.
twoFactor.recoveryCodesLeft: {count, plural, one {You have one recovery code left.} other {You have # recovery codes left.}} Create new codes in your profile.

linkAccount.title: You already have an account
linkAccount.subtitle: An account with a password exists for {email}. Enter the password to connect it with {authProviderShort}. Your shifts and roles will be preserved, and you can log in either way.
linkAccount.expiredDescription: Please log in again with {authProviderShort}. We will ask for your password again.
linkAccount.forgotPasswordHint: Forgot password? {resetLink}, then log in again with {authProviderShort}. Two accounts with the same email cannot exist.
